notes.title: Important Notice Regarding European Region Access
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

 

Due to the changes of our company’s service policy for the European regions, we are saddened to bring you news that, all games and WarpPortal services to the European regions listed below will be terminated on May 25th, 2018.

 

The following European countries will be affected by the termination of service: All the European countries except for Russian Federation and the CIS countries.

 

All WarpPortal game access and account access will be blocked by regional IP.  Refunds will be gradually sent for purchases made from February 1st 2018 to April 30th 2018 to those affected by this service termination.

 

We have updated our User Agreement and Privacy Policy to reflect the new changes going forward.

 

We thank you for your patience and understanding.

notes.title: Steam Trading Card Contest
notes.notes:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/11/steamcardcontest600x200banner.jpg[/img]

It's time to gussy up our Steam section by designing some killer Steam Trading Cards.  Winners will have their art immortalized forever as a Steam Trading card available through Steam!  The contest will go from [b]Nov. 3rd - Nov. 30th[/b]. 
 
We will not be having 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place winners, but will instead choose up to three winners!  These winners will have their designs displayed on Steam as trading cards as well as earn 500 IM Points. 
 
All remaining participants will receive 100 IM points. 
 
However, in order to qualify for the points, you must submit a qualified image. Qualified images must adhere to the rules below. 
 
[b]Rules:[/b]
 
1. There will only be one entry per player.  
- All players attempting to apply more than once on multiple accounts will be disqualified. 
 
2. Must utilize only Metal Assault Approved Assets.  
- To assist with this we have created a fansite kit you may download it from [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B065NOFcv7yUc3NwQlBvTTl6ckE/view]here[/url]. 
 
3. All entries must be suitable for all ages.   
 
4. Event is open to all players regardless of level, experience, or activity. 
 
5. Include your In-game name so that we know who to credit and send prizes to. 
 
6. There are two parts to the entry.  A small and large card.  They must be submitted at exactly [b]1920 px wide x 1080 px tall[/b], with a companion image at [b]206 px wide x 184 px tall[/b].   

7. Please post your entries on our forums [url=https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/226704-steam-trading-card-contest/?p=2735350]here[/url]. 
 
 
Have fun!

Some of the items have adjusted a bit, and you will want to take notice!
Every 7 days of check in, you will now receive a 7 Day Reward Package.
Contained in the 7 Day package are some truly great items to reward you for your attendance!
 

[b]7 Day Reward Package[/b] (random chance to get one of the following)
[list]

[*]AMP 1~3

[/list]

If you make it to 30 days, an even better package awaits you as a reward!

[b]30 Day Reward Package[/b] (random chance to get one of the following)
[list]
[*]Golden.K: Dot Sight, Scope, Laser Sight, Silencer, Magazine
[*]Weapon Crates containing Item Mall weapons for 7 Days, Pistols, Rifle, Rifle (with Grenade Launcher), Sniper, Shotgun, Rocket Launcher, Flamethrower, and Shield.
[*]Angel or Devil Wings (30 Day)
[*]Reinforced Grenade(30D)
[*]A random AMP 1~5
[*]Ladder Speed Booster(30D)
[*]Rare Weapon Random Box
[*]Unique Weapon Random Box
[/list]
These are some pretty amazing rewards if you're able to keep up your attendance!
[b]Just remember, [u]attendance resets every 1st of the month![/u][/b]

[b][h1]Tournaments![/h1][/b]

We're getting Tournaments earlier than I had planned for! (And yes, we're still going to hold our own 2v2 PvP Tournament!)
These tournaments are setup based on our current peak attendance on average every day. We may make adjustments based on feedback, as well as participation.
I've been told that currently, we are limited to only be able to hold 1 Tournament of each type, per day and they have to be at the same time throughout a period.
While I would like to make alterations, I'm mostly just excited to see it get put in so soon from our initial discussion of expectations!
So let's enjoy, and please be sure to leave me feedback about it and we'll work on changes for the future.

As far as I'm aware, here is what the schedules for tournaments will be in-game
[b]Monday ~ Friday[/b][list]
[*]Daily Solo Tournaments will be at 15:30 (3:30pm Server Time, -08:00 UTC)
[*]Daily Company Tournaments will be at 17:30 (5:30pm Server Time, -08:00 UTC)
[/list]
[b]Saturday & Sunday[/b][list]
[*]Weekly Solo Tournament at 15:30 (3:30pm Server Time, -08:00 UTC)
[*]Weekly Company Tournament at 17:30 (5:30pm Server Time, -08:00 UTC)
 [/list]

[b][h1]Some additional heads up![/h1][/b]

There were a few more changes you might like to be aware of!
[list]
[*]Sing, your personal storage NPC, took a stroll and is now located in the Town Square.
[*]Unique weapon repair cost has been reduced!
[*]The maximum upgrade level has been increased from 12 to 20!
[*]A beginner channel is being provided, for players under level 26.
Some feedback has expressed some difficulty where new players were finding it difficult to match up with the more veteran players and felt discourage.
This new channel should help give the opportunity to fight with like peers to start and fine tune their skills, which they can later step in to challenge more veteran players.
[/list]

[b]Personal note from Leonis[/b]
I'm honestly very excited and impressed how much effort GNISoft has put in to getting back to us on the many things I've been sending them, from YOUR feedback within the community. I truly hope this helps liven things up, and make your experience more fun all around. I will of course continue working with you and the development team on your feedback, to further making Metal Assault AWESOME.

Keep watch for news of when maintenance concludes, and we can all jump in and see the new changes. :)
